title: La Gritería
goal: Go door to door and keep up with the responses
culture: Six in the evening, the bells go and the fireworks start, and the entire city walks out of its houses at once. You will do thirty houses, the good ones run out, and every barrio knows which house does the big gorras.

beats.es: (Suenan las campanas y empiezan los cohetes. Son las seis.)
beats.good: Six in the evening, bells and rockets, and the whole city out of doors within about four minutes. Ya empezó is what everybody says.
La Gritería — the shouting. That is genuinely its name and it is a completely accurate description of the evening.

beats.es: (Ya llevan cuatro casas. La bolsa va pesando.)
beats.objective: Move him on to the next one
beats.good: You are doing thirty houses tonight and the good ones run out. Vamos is said constantly and always slightly urgently.

beats.objective: Agree to queue at this one
beats.en: They give good stuff here? Then we’ll wait.
beats.good: Dan bueno — they give good stuff. Every barrio knows which house does the big gorras, and there will be a queue outside it.
